title: Heroes of the Storm PTR Patch Notes - November 9, 2026
description:
Our next Heroes of the Storm patch has just hit the Public Test Realm and will be available for playtesting. As always, if you encounter any bugs during your PTR play sessions, please stop by the PTR Bug Report forum to let us know about your experiences.

Quick Navigation:

• Balance Update

• Bug Fixes

Balance Update

Heroes

Chromie

Talents

• Level 1 Once Again the First Time Damage increased from 50% to 55%.

• Deep Breathing Damage bonus per stack increased from 0.5% to 0.6%.

• Timewalker's Pursuit Damage bonus reduced from 15% to 12%.

Gazlowe

Base

• Basic Attack damage increased from 100 to 105.

• Health increased from 2275 to 2375.

• Deth Lazor [W] Life Leech increased from 25% to 30%.

Talents

• Level 20 Bomb Toss No longer grants an additional charge.

Greymane

Talents

• Level 7 Incendiary Elixir Damage bonus per stack increased from 25 to 30.

• Level 20 Gilnean Roulette No longer reduces the percentage based Health damage.

Lúcio

Talents

• Level 1 Party Mix Quest completion radius bonus increased from 20% to 30%.

• Level 10 Sound Barrier Shield amount per stack increased from 27 to 31.

• Level 13 Slip Lingering duration increased from 1 to 2 seconds.

• Level 20 Summer Anthem Unkillable duration increased from 1.5 to 2.5 seconds.

Medivh

Base

• Arcane Rift [Q] Damage increased from 170 to 185.

• Force of Will [W] Cooldown reduced from 9 to 8 seconds.

• Portal [E] Cooldown increased from 16 to 20 seconds.

Talents

• Level 1 Winds of Celerity Now also reduces cast time by 0.25 seconds.

• Raven's Intellect Bonus increased from 200% to 400%.

• Portal Mastery No longer allows Medivh to cast Portal in Raven Form without dismounting.

• Level 4 Dust of Appearance Cooldown reduced from 45 to 40 seconds.

• Now allows Medivh to cast Portal in Raven Form without dismounting.

Mei

Base

• Blizzard [W] Detonation delay reduced from 2 to 1.875 seconds.

• Detonation damage increased from 75 to 80.

• Icing [E] Cast time reduced from 0.625 to 0.5 seconds.

Talents

• Level 10 Avalanche Cooldown reduced from 90 to 80 seconds.

• Ice Wall Cast time reduced from 0.75 to 0.6875 seconds.

Mephisto

Talents

• Level 1 Malicious Intent Spell Power bonus increased from 25% to 30%.

• Duration increased from 2.5 to 3 seconds.

• Level 4 Hateful Mending Mana restored increased from 10 to 15.

• Healing increased from 70% to 85%.

• Static Barrier Shield amount increased from 40% to 50%.

Stukov

Talents

• Level 1 Fetid Touch Cooldown reduction increased from 5 to 6 seconds.

• Level 10 Flailing Swipe Damage increased from 48 to 62.

Xal'atath

Base

• Shadow Mark [Q] Range increased from 8 to 9.

• Dark Heart Ritual [W] Detonation damage increased from 245 to 260.

• Void Volley [D] Mythic Reward damage bonus reduced from 50% to 35%.

Talents

• Level 1 Anchored Core No longer increases duration.

• Cloak of Shadows Now grants Spell Armor only while actively blinking. The bonus no longer persists for 2 seconds.

• Level 4 Cold Feet Duration bonus increased from 1 to 2 seconds.

• Level 7 Toxic Mark No longer increases debuff duration.

• Now benefits from Cold Feet's duration bonus.

• Level 10 Void Eruption Damage per second reduced by 10%.

• Speed reduced by 10%.

• Level 16 Marked Resilience Shield amount increased from 160 to 200.

• Relentless Whispers No longer increases Attack Speed.

• Now grants an additional 75% Basic Attack damage per teleport.

• Fractured Reality Damage bonus reduced from 25% to 15%.

• Level 20 Harbinger's Consumption Cooldown reduction per hit reduced from 14 to 10 seconds.

• The three orbs now orbit more slowly.

• Unstable Core No longer applies a damage over time to targets.

• Impact damage increased from 45 to 75.

Bug Fixes

General

• Fixed an issue with the death icon at certain resolutions. Begone pesky pixel!

• Spell Power no longer increases the Health restored by activating Hearthstone (B).

• Fixed an issue with allied pings on the Party Frame.

Maps

• Fixed an issue that caused Sapper attacks to instantly hit nearby targets.

• Fixed an issue that caused Sapper warning areas to persist indefinitely.

• Auriel Level 16 Wrath of Heaven Fixed an issue that caused Wrath of Heaven's full Spell Power bonus to apply to healing.

• Blaze Level 13 Adhesive Petroleum Fixed an issue that caused Adhesive Petroleum to grant its Basic Attack damage bonus to other Blaze players who do not have the talent selected.

• Genji Level 1 Pathfinder Fixed an issue that caused Genji to no longer automatically acquire nearby targets after Pathfinder expires.

• Greymane Level 4 Eyes in the Dark Fixed an issue that caused Genji to no longer automatically acquire nearby targets after Eyes in the Dark expires.

• Li Li Base Cloud Serpent [W] Fixed an issue that allowed Cloud Serpent casts on allied Heroes to become disjointed.

• Medivh Level 13 Circle of Protection Added a radius indicator to Force of Will's cast guide after selecting Circle of Protection.

• Level 20 Dust of Disappearance Fixed an issue that caused targeted allies to not automatically acquire nearby targets after Stealth expires.

• Tassadar Level 13 Shadow Walk Fixed an issue that caused Tassadar to no longer automatically acquire nearby targets after Shadow Walk expires.

• Xal'atath Base Fixed an issue with Xal'atath's Health Regeneration.

• Shadow Mark [Q] Fixed issues that caused Structures to be marked by Shadow Mark in unintended situations.

• Dark Heart Ritual [W] Fixed issues related to Dark Heart Ritual's self reveal logic.

• Void Volley [D] Fixed an issue that caused Void Volley to gain progress when attacking a target with 1 Evasion charge remaining.

• Level 4 Void Acolyte Fixed an issue that caused Void Acolyte to not empower Void Volley.

• Level 7 Void Summoner Fixed an issue that caused Void Summoner to not spawn the Void Minion at Xal'atath's position at cast time.

• Xul Base Bone Prison [E] Xul will no longer be revealed to the enemy if he is in the fog of war when Bone Prison activates.

title: Heroes of the Storm PTR Patch Notes - September 14, 2026
description:
Our next Heroes of the Storm patch has just hit the Public Test Realm and will be available for playtesting. As always, if you encounter any bugs during your PTR play sessions, please stop by the PTR Bug Report forum to let us know about your experiences.

Quick Navigation:

• New Hero

• General

• Map Updates

• Balance Update

• Bug Fixes

New Hero: Xal'atath

Xal'atath has arrived in the Nexus!

Base

• Shadow Mark [Q] Shoot a single Void Orb that deals 45 damage to enemies hit. Enemies hit by the center take an additional 90 damage.

• Enemy Heroes directly hit are Marked for 4 seconds.

• Marked Heroes are Revealed and draw the Dark Heart and Void Minions toward them.

• Void Step [W] Cast to teleport Xal'atath 3 times in a triangular pattern.

• Each time Xal'atath teleports, her Basic Attacks deal +25% damage while the ability is active.

• Reactivate to end Void Step early and remain at the current location.

• Dark Heart Ritual [E] Summon the Dark Heart, which pulses for 35 damage per second to nearby enemies for 8 seconds.

• The Dark Heart moves to Shadow Mark's impact location.

• The Dark Heart pursues Marked Heroes and detonates on impact, dealing 120 damage to nearby enemies and an additional 60 damage to the Marked target.

• Void Volley [Trait] Void Volley is charged by Xal'atath's Basic Attacks. Unleash a barrage of Void Orbs at a target location, each dealing 99 damage on impact.

• Quest: Hit enemy Heroes with Void Volley. Each Hero hit grants 1 stack and increases all Void damage by .1%. Xal'atath loses all stacks when killed Reward (30 Stacks): Increase Void Volley's range by 2. Upon death, Xal'atath now only loses 6 stacks, but cannot fall below her current milestone minimum

• Reward (55 Stacks): Void Volley requires 1 fewer Basic Attack to charge Void Volley.

• Mythic Reward (90 Stacks): Increase Void Attack and Ability damage by 50%. Void Volley projectiles Pierce all targets.

Talents

• Level 1 Anchored Core Increase Dark Heart's area by 50% and duration by 50%.

• Dark Heart's damage bounces 2 times from the primary target to nearby enemies, dealing 18 damage.

• Cloak of Shadows Activating Void Step grants 50% Movement Speed and 25 Spell Armor for 2 seconds. This bonus refreshes each time Xal'atath teleports.

• Toxic Mark Increase Shadow Mark's duration by 1 second.

• Damage over time dealt to Marked Heroes is increased to 1% of their maximum Health. Marked enemies have -15 Armor while Marked.

• Level 4 Dark Barrier Each time Dark Heart damages an enemy, Xal'atath gains a Shield equal to 2% of her maximum Health, up to 10%.

• Void Acolyte Completing Void Step fully charges Void Volley.

• The next Void Volley deals 50% increased damage and costs no Mana.

• Cold Feet Increase Shadow Mark's duration by 1 second.

• Marked enemies are Slowed by 25%.

• Level 7 Void Summoner Activating Void Step summons a single Void Minion in its center. Void Minions are attracted to Shadow Marked Heroes.

• Void Minion Basic Attacks deal 95 damage per hit. Void Minions lose Health over 30 seconds.

• Void Adept Quest: Detonate the Dark Heart on Marked enemy Heroes to increase Shadow Mark's damage by 5 each time a target is hit, up to 100 additional damage.

• Silence of the Lamb Activating Void Step summons a seal of Void magic on the ground. When the seal completes, it deals 99 damage to enemies inside and Silences them for 2 seconds.

• Level 10 Void Eruption [R] Channel a single powerful Void Orb that grows over time until reaching maximum size after 2 seconds. Recast to launch the Orb early.

• Enemies that come into contact with the Orb take up to 175 damage and are Blinded for 1 second.

• When the Orb reaches the end of its path, it detonates in a large explosion, dealing up to 700 damage.

• The Orb deals contact damage every 0.125 seconds.

• Void Convergence [R] After channeling for 2 seconds, summon a Void Portal that spawns up to 4 Void Minions to attack nearby enemies.

• Enemies near the Void Portal are Slowed by 25%.

• Void Minions are attracted to Shadow Marked Heroes.

• The Portal loses health over 20 seconds.

• Level 13 Crushing Cascade Enemies hit by Void Volley are Slowed by 6% for 2 seconds per projectile, up to 50%.

• Dark Heart's Protection Casting Dark Heart Silences enemies inside its radius for 1 second.

• Xal'atath and allied Heroes gain 30 Spell Armor while inside Dark Heart's radius.

• Relentless Whispers While Void Step is active, Xal'atath's Basic Attack rate is increased by 200%.

• Level 16 Pull of the Dark Heart Linked enemies are Slowed by 10% for each pulse, stacking up to 5 times and decaying over 2 seconds.

• Marked Resilience Basic Attacks against Marked Heroes grant a 480 point Shield that rapidly decays.

• Fractured Reality Increase Void Volley projectile damage by 25%.

• Void Volley projectiles leave a trail of fire along their path for 3 seconds, dealing 15 damage over time.

• The trail deals damage every 1 second.

• Level 20 Harbinger's Consumption Xal'atath's Void Eruption splits into 3 orbiting Void Orbs.

• Cancelling the ability early causes the orbs to travel faster.

• Rift Invasion Void Convergence's Portal no longer loses health over time and can spawn and sustain up to 6 Void Minions.

• Dueling Orbs Gain 1 additional Shadow Mark charge.

• Unstable Core When the Dark Heart expires or detonates on a Marked Hero, it leaves behind a pool of void flames for 5 seconds.

• Enemies in the flames take 15 damage over time.

• The flames deal damage every 1 second.

• Paradox Loop After completing Void Step, Xal'atath immediately performs a second Void Step in the opposite direction. Added effects are triggered again.

General

• Updated Homescreen and Startup Music.

Map Updates

• Garden of Terror Shambler Health and damage now begin 25% below their previous values and gradually return to their previous values over the course of the match.

Balance Update

Heroes

Abathur

Talents

• Level 13 Bombard Strain Health decay reduction lowered from 50% to 40%.

• Level 16 Survival Instincts Now provides 50% damage reduction against non-Heroes, instead of +100% Health.

Alexstrasza

Base

• Health increased from 1698 to 1780.

Talents

• Level 16 Overprotective Shield reduced from 70% of healing to 50%.

Garrosh

Talents

• Level 1 Unrivaled Strength Damage bonus reduced from 125% to 75%.

• Level 4 In For The Kill Damage bonus increased from 70% to 100%.

• Level 7 Oppressor Spell Power reduction decreased from 30% to 25%.

• Level 13 Bloodcraze Heal duration increased from 3 seconds to 4 seconds. Total healing remains the same.

• Double Up Armor duration increased from 3 seconds to 5 seconds.

Mal'Ganis

Base

• Night Rush [E] Cast time reduced from 0.75 seconds to 0.625 seconds.

• Vampiric Touch [D] Healing based on damage against Heroes increased from 45% to 50%.

• Healing based on damage against non-Heroes increased from 10% to 15%.

Qhira

Base

• Blood Rage [W] Damage bonus per stack decreased from 0.25% to 0.2%.

• Blood Rage base damage per tick lowered from 8 to 7.

Talents

• Level 1 Fatal Wounds Damage bonus against low Health targets increased from 50% to 70%.

• Level 13 Pulsing Pain Damage increased from 135 to 150.

• Level 16 Lingering Ailment Armor reduction decreased from -35 to -25.

Whitemane

Base

• Desperate Plea [Q] Base mana cost increased from 40 to 45. Mana scaling with each use is unchanged.

Talents

• Level 7 Intercession Cooldown increased from 60 to 75 seconds.

• Level 16 Radiance Healing increased from 175 to 190.

Yrel

Base

• Vindication [Q] Mana cost increased from 50 to 65.

Talents

• Level 13 Aldor Peacekeeper Damage reduction increased from 40% to 50%.

• Damage reduction duration increased from 3 seconds to 4 seconds.

• Velen's Chosen Damage bonus per stack decreased from 10% to 8%.

• Level 20 Seraphim Cooldown increased from 20 to 30 seconds.

Bug Fixes

Malfurion

• Fixed an issue where Entangling Roots would not continuously root enemies within its area.

Xul

• Fixed an issue where Xul's skeletons were sometimes not dealing damage.

Click here to discuss this post with other players in the official Heroes of the Storm forums .

title: Heroes of the Storm PTR Patch Notes - June 29, 2026
description:
Our next Heroes of the Storm patch has just hit the Public Test Realm and will be available for playtesting. As always, if you encounter any bugs during your PTR play sessions, please stop by the PTR Bug Report forum to let us know about your experiences.

Quick Navigation:

• General

• Map Updates

• Balance Update

• Bug Fixes

General

• Players can now party with unplaced players in Storm League.

• Haunted Mines has been added to Ranked.

Map Updates

• Hanamura Additional brush has been added in several locations.

• Warhead Junction Warhead's channel penalty on interrupt reduced from 10 to 5 seconds.

Balance Update

Heroes

Abathur

Base

• Spawn Locust [D] Health reduced from 350 to 225.

• Locusts now heal for 20% of the damage they deal, and heal for 20% of their maximum Health when a nearby Minion dies.

Talents

• Level 1 Envenomed Nests Armor reduction increased from 10 to 15.

• Locust Brood Moved from Level 16 to Level 1.

• Cooldown increased from 45 to 75 seconds.

• Level 4 (New) Slapathur Abathur's Basic Attacks now Stun non-Heroes and deal 500% additional damage.

• Level 10 Evolve Monstrosity Now displays as a Quest.

• Abathur now has a Monstrosity unit frame, for tracking Health and stacks of the unit.

• Level 16 Survival Intincts Moved from Level 1 to Level 16.

• Health bonus increased from 100% to 200%.

Alexstrasza

Base

• Dragonqueen [D] Cooldown now starts after Dragonqueen has expired.

• Cooldown reduced from 150 to 130 seconds.

• Talents that affect Gift of Life also apply to Breath of Life.

• Talents that affect Abundance also apply to Preservation.

• Breath of Life [Dragonqueen Q] Healing reduced from 20% to 15%.

• Preservation [Dragonqueen W] Healing reduced from 30% to 25%.

Talents

• Level 1 Live and Let Live Now also provides 25% recharge rate for Breath of Life.

• Flames of Fury NEW MYTHIC REWARD: Hit an additional 40 Heroes without dying to cause Dragonqueen's duration to be refreshed when damaging an enemy Hero.

• Level 7 Life Blossom Now makes Breath of Life remove Slows and Roots.

• Transforming into Dragonqueen will no longer remove the collected Lifeblossom.

• Level 16 Draconic Dicipline No longer affect's Dragonqueen's duration.

• For each allied Hero healed with Dragonqueen's Basic Attacks, reduce the cooldown of Preservation by 1.25 seconds.

• Level 20 On Ruby Wings Rework: If at least 3 Heroes are in an area hit by a Fireball, that Fireball charge is not consumed.

• Ancient Flame Does not provide Quest stacks while active.

Blaze

Talents

• Level 1 Adrenaline Stim Active Attack Speed bonus reduced from 100% to 85%.

• Level 10 Bunker Drop Cooldown increased from 80 to 85 seconds.

Cho

Talents

• Level 7 Calloused Hide Health threshold required to trigger reduced from 60% to 40%.

• Level 7 Firestarter Cooldown reduction per Basic Attack increased from 1 to 1.5 seconds.

Gall

Talents

• Level 4 Rising Dread Bonus per bounce reduced from 25% to 20%.

• Bomb's Away No longer has a cap on stacks.

• Damage bonus per stack lowered from 5 to 4.

• Level 7 Double Trouble Shadowflame's cooldown reduction from Quest Reward increased from 0.5 to 1 second.

• Level 16 Leaden Orb Stun duration reduced from 0.75 seconds to 0.6 seconds.

Chromie

Base

• Dragon's Breath [W] Now shows a radius preview to enemies.

• Time Trap [E] Health reduced from 400 to 250.

Talents

• Level 1 Once Again The First Time Quest requirement reduced from 40 to 20 stacks.

• Quest must now be completed without dying.

• Deep Breathing Damage per stack reduced from 1% to 0.5%.

• No longer has a cap on stacks.

• Level 4 Chronic Conditions Now also causes Time Trap to activate automatically upon touching an enemy Hero.

• Slow reduced from 30% to 20%.

• Movement Speed bonus reduced from 30% to 20%.

• Level 13 Here and There Range increased from 20 to 40.

• Snap targetting is now used. The Echo nearest the player's target position will be used.

Diablo

Base

• Shadow Charge Damage increased from 40 plus 130 with a collision, to 45 plus 140 with a collision.

• Fire Stomp Damage decreased from 12 on expansion and 36 on return to 11 on expansion and 34 on return.

• Overpower Damage increased from 73 to 80.

Talents

• Level 7 Diabolical Momentum Cooldown reduction per Basic Attack increased from 1.5 to 2 seconds.

• Level 20 Dying Breath Cooldown reduction per Hero hit increased from 25 to 30 seconds.

• Lord of Terror Health stolen increased from 10% to 12% maximum Health.

Genji

Talents

• Level 1 Swift as the Wind Movement Speed bonus increased from 30% to 40%.

• Level 4 Strike at the Heart Damage increased from 134 to 142.

• Level 7 Perfect Defense Cooldown reduction per hit increased from 2 to 2.5 seconds.

• Level 13 Flow Like Water Cooldown reduction per hit increased from 3 to 4 seconds.

• Level 16 Final Cut Damage reduced from 125 to 115.

Johanna

Base

• Shield Glare [E] Cooldown increased from 12 to 13 seconds.

Talents

• Level 10 Blessed Shield Cooldown increased from 60 to 65 seconds.

Mal'Ganis

Talents

• Level 1 Will of Tichondrius Stun's duration increase reduced from 0.5 to 0.25 seconds.

• Level 16 Blind as a Bat There is now a 0.2 second reactivation delay upon finishing 3 swipes of Fel Claws. This matches the time between other swipes.

Qhira

Base

• Revolving Sweep [Q] Once attached, Revolving Sweep can no longer be detached by the target becoming Unstoppable.

• Blood Rage [W] NEW BASELINE QUEST: Deal damage to enemy Heroes with Blood Rage's bleed to permanently increase its damage by 0.5% per stack.

• Blood Rage's bleed damage reduced from 11 to 8.

Talents

• Level 1 Fatal Wounds Damage bonus against low Health targets increased from 30% to 50%.

• Quest removed.

Ragnaros

Base

• Blast Wave [W] Damage increased from 104 to 120.

• Molten Core [D] Cooldown increased from 120 to 180 seconds.

• Health increased from 3996 to 5000.

• Duration increased from 18 to 23 seconds.

• Ragnaros is now Stunned for 1 second upon exiting.

• Meteor Swing [Molten Core Q] Damage increased from 161 to 250.

• No longer deals increased damage to Minions.

• Cooldown increased from 6 seconds to 9 seconds.

• Now also knocks enemies back.

• Meteor Shower [Molten Core W] Damage increased from 151 to 200.

• Cooldown increased from 2.5 to 6 seconds.

• Area of effect increased by 66%.

• Delay between hits significantly increased.

• No longer deals increased damage to Minions.

• Slow increased from 25% to 35%.

• Range reduced from 35 to 20, but now it extends up to 35 over time.

• Now deals 75% reduced damage to Structures.

• Explosive Rune [Molten Core E] Cooldown decreased from 4 to 2.5 seconds.

• Now applies a DOT that deals 88 damage per second for 5 seconds to impacted targets. No longer deals instant damage.

• Range reduced from 35 to 20, but now it extends up to 35 over time.

• No longer deals increased damage to Minions.

• Now deals 75% reduced damage to Structures.

Talents

• Level 1 Engulfing Flame Damage bonus reduced from 75% to 50%.

• Level 10 Sulfuras Smash NEW MYTHIC QUEST: Hit 8 enemy Heroes with the center of Sulfuras Smash. Mythic Reward: Sulfuras Smash gains an extra charge.

• Level 20 Lava Surge No longer reduces the cooldown of Lava Wave by 30 seconds.

• Now also gives +200% Movement Speed to allied Minions and Mercenaries in its path.

• Heroic Difficulty NEW FUNCTIONALITY: Decrease the cooldown of Molten Core by 110 seconds when used on a dead Fort or Keep. In addition, the starting range of abilities in Molten Core are increased by 100% and will continue to grow.

Whitemane

Base

• Searing Lash [E] NEW QUEST: Hit Heroes with Searing Lash to increase Whitemane's maximum Health by 3 and Mana by 2.

Talents

• Level 1 Pity the Frail Cooldown reduction per hit reduced from 1.5 to 1 second.

• Inquisitor's Prayer REWORK: For each Hero hit by Searing Lash, restore 25 Mana. Passive: Zeal's duration is increased by 2 seconds.

• Level 7 Intercession Cooldown increased 45 to 60 seconds.

• Level 13 Scarlet Wrath Mana restore increased from 0.5% to 1%.

• Level 20 Guiding Light Now also increases the Spell Power gained from Zeal's activation by 15%.

Yrel

Base

• Righteous Hammer [Q] Heal increased from 320 to 370.

• Damage increased from 140 to 160.

• Righteous Hammer [W] Stun duration increased from 0.75 1 second.

• Damage increased from 125 to 140.

• Avenging Wrath [E] Slow increased from 50% to 60%.

• Damage increased from 225 to 260.

• Divine Purpose [D] Cooldown increased to from 8 to 16 seconds.

• Cooldown is now reduced by 8 seconds whenever Yrel's Basic Abilities are interrupted.

Talents

• Level 4 Hand of Freedom Cooldown increased from 30 to 40 seconds.

• Movement Speed bonus reduced from 30% to 25%.

• Level 20 Seraphim Cooldown increased from 10 to 20 seconds.

Bug Fixes

General

• Attack beams from Forts, Keeps, and the Core will now be more visible when attacking Heroes.

Maps

• Haunted Mines Fixed an issue where the player would not auto-mount when using the Hearthstone from inside the mines.

• Warhead Junction Fixed an issue that caused Heroes to not be revealed while launching a Warhead.

• Fixed an issue that caused the Warhead's channel beam to persist when interrupted.

Heroes

• Ana Level 10 Eye of Horus No longer reveals in a global line when hitting a Structure.

• Removed a minor delay when dealing damage to enemy Heroes.

• Anub'arak Base Scarab Host [Trait] Fixed an issue that caused Beetles created by Ultimate Evolution clones of Anub'arak to not gain Spell Power bonuses.

• Fixed an issue that caused Anub'arak's Beetles to not have their damage reduced by D.Va's Defense Matrix.

• Level 7 Leeching Scarabs Fixed an issue that caused the healing done by Leeching Scarabs to not be affected by damage modifiers.

• Arthas Base Howling Blast [W] Fixed an issue where the visuals of Howling Blast didn't match the area hit.

• Level 10 Army of the Dead Fixed an issue that caused Arthas's Ghouls to not have their damage reduced by D.Va's Defense Matrix.

• Deathwing Base Cataclysm [R] Deathwing will no longer be teleported to where Cataclysm is targeted if he is killed during Cataclysm.

• Deckard Level 10 Lorenado Fixed an issue that caused Lorenado to not deal damage to Unstoppable enemies.

• Hogger Level 20 No Control Fixed an issue that caused No Control to target enemies that are not visible.

• Jaina Base Frostbolt [Q] Fixed an issue that caused Frosbolt's range indicator and actual range to not match.

• Fixed an issue that caused Frosbot used by Ultimate Evolution clones of Jaina to not gain Spell Power bonuses.

• Blizzard [W] Fixed an issue that caused Blizzard used by Ultimate Evolution clones of Jaina to not gain Spell Power bonuses.

• Cone of Cold [E] Fixed an issue that caused Cone of Cold used by Ultimate Evolution clones of Jaina to not gain Spell Power bonuses.

• Level 10 Summon Water Elemental Water Elemental's Basic Attacks damage now inherits all damage modifiers placed on Jaina.

• Level 20 Wintermute Fixed an issue that caused Water Elemental's Wintermute effects to deal more damage than intended to Chilled targets.

• Wintermute's Blizzard damage now inherits all damage modifiers placed on Jaina.

• Wintermute's Cone of Cold damage now inherits all damage modifiers placed on Jaina.

• Wintermute's Cone of Cold now initiates its Cone of Cold cast at the same time Jaina initiates her cast and will be interrupted if it or Jaina is interrupted.

• Wintermute's Frostbolt damage now inherits all damage modifiers placed on Jaina.

• Wintermute's Frostbolt now initiates its Frostbolt cast at the same time Jaina initiates her cast and will be interrupted if it or Jaina is interrupted.

• Kerrigan Level 10 Summon Ultralisk Fixed an issue that caused Kerrigan's Ultralisk to not have its damage reduced by D.Va's Defense Matrix.

• Leoric Level 16 Royal Focus Now displays the remaining duration around the Skeletal Swing's button.

• Malfurion Level 1 Vengeful Roots Fixed an issue that caused Malfurion's Treant to not have its damage reduced by D.Va's Defense Matrix.

• Treant's damage will now display as Vengeful Roots in the Death Recap.

• Medivh Level 4 Raven Familiar Fixed an issue that caused Medivh's Raven Familiar created by Ultimate Evolution clones of Medivh to not gain Spell Power bonuses.

• Level 20 Guardian of Tirisfal Fixed an issue that caused targets near the edge of Arcane Rift's range with Guardian of Tirisfal to not be hit.

• Nazeebo Base Voodoo Ritual [Trait] Quest progress indicators will now show around the killed enemy Minion.

• Quest progress will now be gained in instances where a second Nazeebo damages the target and the target dies within 6 seconds of the first Nazeebo applying Voodoo Ritual.

• Fixed an issue that caused stacks of Voodoo Ritual gained prior to selecting Thing of the Deep to not be granted to Thing of the Deep.

• Fixed an issue that caused Vodoo Ritual's tooltip to display the incorrrect total damage value.

• Fixed an issue that caused Vile Infection's tooltip to display the incorrrect total damage value.

• Level 1 Thing of the Deep No longer causes Voodoo Ritual to display two Quest indicators.

• Level 4 Blood Ritual Fixed an issue that caused Blood Ritual to not grant Health or Mana when the target affected by Voodoo Ritual timed out due to their Health passively being reduced.

• Nova Level 20 Fast Reload Fixed an issue that caused Fast Reload to trigger when a Triple Tap target dies before it hits them.

• Probius Base Photon Cannon [E] Fixed an issue that caused Probius's Photon Cannons to not have their damage reduced by D.Va's Defense Matrix.

• Level 1 Gathering Minerals Now also empowers any Photon Cannon already on the battlefield upon Quest completion.

• Tychus Base Overkill [Q] Fixed an issue that caused Overkill to reveal unintended areas.

• Xul Base Raise Skeleton [Trait] Fixed an issue that caused Xul's Skeletal Warriors to not have their damage reduced by D.Va's Defense Matrix.

• Level 10 Skeletal Mages Fixed an issue that caused Xul's Skeletal Mages to not have their damage reduced by D.Va's Defense Matrix.

• Fixed an issue that caused Xul's Skeletal Mages to not apply their Slow in an aura while Blinded or against Evading Heroes.

• Fixed an issue that caused Xul's Skeletal Mages to not apply their Slow with their attacks against Heroes with Heroic Attack only Evasion effects.

• Level 16 Weaken Fixed an issue that caused Xul's Skeletal Warriors to not apply Weaken's damage reduction while Xul is Blinded or against Heroes with Heroic Attack only Evasion effects.

• Zagara Base Infested Drop [E] Fixed an issue that caused Roaches created by Ultimate Evolution clones of Zagara to not gain Spell Power bonuses.

title: Heroes of the Storm PTR Patch Notes - March 30, 2026
description:
Our next Heroes of the Storm patch has just hit the Public Test Realm and will be available for playtesting. As always, if you encounter any bugs during your PTR play sessions, please stop by the PTR Bug Report forum to let us know about your experiences.

Quick Navigation:

• General

• Map Updates

• Balance Update

• Bug Fixes

General

• Unranked Mode has been removed.

• Respawn timers have been reduced in the mid-to-late game. By level 22, respawn timers are back at 65 Seconds.

• Updated Homescreen and Startup Music.

Map Updates

• Garden of Terror Classic The original Garden of Terror has returned to Custom Games!

• The name has been changed to Garden of Terror Classic to differentiate from the current Garden of Terror.

• Haunted Mines Haunted mines has returned to Quick Match!

• Map objective is now complete when one team collects 55 Skulls, rather than when all 100 Skulls have been collected.

• Hero vision is reduced while in the mines.

• Warhead Junction Cast time for Nuke increased from 2.5 seconds to 3 seconds.

title: Heroes of the Storm PTR Patch Notes - January 14, 2026
description:
Our next Heroes of the Storm patch has just hit the Public Test Realm and will be available for playtesting. As always, if you encounter any bugs during your PTR play sessions, please stop by the PTR Bug Report forum to let us know about your experiences.

Quick Navigation:

• General

• Map Updates

• Balance Update

• Known Issues & Bug Fixes

General

• All Quests that can lose stacks will never cause the player to fall below milestone thresholds.

• Pinnacle Rewards are now named Mythic Rewards to give a more Blizzard feel. So Mythic-y!

• The following Summoned Units now lose health each second: Demon Lieutenants, Demon Warriors, Gargantuan, Hydralisks, Roaches, Rock-It Turrets, Rush Zombies, Scarabs, Treants, Tumors, and Water Elementals. Total Health and Duration of these Summoned Units have been adjusted to compensate for this.

• Structures now prioritize Summoned Units when there are no remaining minions.

• Summoned Units no longer take half damage from Structures.

• XP Globe pickup sound is now also played when killing a minion that instantly yields XP.

• Updated Homescreen and Startup Music.

Map Updates

• General Watch Towers will now reset to neutral after 45 seconds of not being occupied.

• Volskaya Foundry Triglav Protector bonus Damage and cooldown speed increased from 25% to 40% when 2 players are inside.

• Warhead Junction The burn duration is now displayed on structures affected by a Warhead.

Balance Update

Heroes

Azmodan

Base

• Globe of Annihilation [Q] Now deals 50% damage to non-Heroes.

• Upon reaching 225 Annihilation, Globe of Annihilation no longer deals reduced damage to non-Heroes.

• Window to kill minions for Annihilation increased to 3s (from 1.5s).

• Summon Demon Warrior [W] Demon Warriors damage increased from 32 to 83. Now deals half damage to Heroes.

• Demon Warriors no longer have a duration, but lose 26 Health every second.

Deathwing

Base

• Attack Damage decreased from 155 to 110.

• Earth Shatter [E] Projectile speed increased by 30%

• Damage over Time stacks reduced from 4 to 3.

• Initial damage bonus increased from 125% to 150%.

• Level 7 Firestorm Damage increased from 70 to 77.

• No longer reduces cooldown of Dragonflight.

• Level 13 Fire and Fury Damage bonus increased from 30% to 40%.

Falstad

Base

• Lightning Rod [W] Range reduced by .5.

• Time between strikes increased from .8 seconds to .9 seconds.

Jaina

Base

• Frostbite [Trait] NEW QUEST: Deal Ability Damage to Frostbitten Heroes. Upon reaching 12,000 Damage, unlock Improved Ice Block, which allows Jaina to become temporarily Invulnerable. Mythic Reward: Upon dealing 30,000 Damage, Ice Block upgrades to Ice Cold, granting Jaina Protected instead of Stasis.

Talents

• Level 16 Numbing Blast Root duration reduced from 1 second to .75 seconds.

Kael'thas

Talents

• Level 1 Convection Increased reward damage and health from 150/50 to 200/100.

Muradin

Base

• Storm Bolt [Q] Perfect Storm Quest removed.

At 35 stacks, Storm Bolt pierces to hit an additional target, and Muradin's Basic Attack reduces the cooldown of Storm Bolt by 0.5 seconds. Mythic Reward: At 150 stacks, Storm Bolt's range is increased by 50% and width is increased by 100%, and now pierces all targets.

Talents

Sylvanas

Talents

• Level 4 Mercenary Queen Now also causes Sylvanas' Basic Attacks to instantly apply 3 stacks of Black Arrows to Mercs.

Thrall

Base

• Basic Attack damage decreased from 173 to 167.

Talents

• Level 1 Crash Lightning Mythic Reward Damage bonus increased from 270 to 325.

• Echo of the Elements Mythic Reward now also allows Chain Lightning to bounce back to the same target.

Tyrande

Base

• Mana reduced from 500 to 450.

After hitting 20 Heroes, Sentinel now pierces the first Hero hit. Mythic Reward: After hitting 50 Heroes, Tyrande's Basic Attacks occasionally trigger a Lunar Flare.

Talents

• Level 1 Ranger No longer provides pierce.

• Level 7 Elune's Gift NEW: Grants 20% Spell Power for 10 seconds after hitting an enemy with Lunar Flare.

• Level 20 Commander of Sentinels NEW: Sentinel now has an additional charge.

Known Issues & Bug Fixes

Known Issues

• Jaina Ice Cold's tooltip is incorrect.

Bug Fixes

Heroes

title: Heroes of the Storm PTR Patch Notes - November 3, 2025
description:
Our next Heroes of the Storm patch has just hit the Public Test Realm and will be available for playtesting. As always, if you encounter any bugs during your PTR play sessions, please stop by the PTR Bug Report forum to let us know about your experiences.

Quick Navigation:

• General

• Map Updates

• Balance Update

• Bug Fixes

General

• Updated Homescreen and Startup Music.

Map Updates

• General A new Fallback Tower has been added to the longer lanes on each of the following battleground maps. This new tower will die when its corresponding Fort dies: Alterac Pass, Battlefield of Eternity, Blackheart's Bay, Braxis Holdout, Cursed Hollow, Dragon Shire, Garden of Terror, Hanamura Temple, Infernal Shrines, Sky Temple, Tomb of the Spider Queen, Volskaya Foundry, and Warhead Junction.

• Attacks from the Core, Keeps, Forts, Fallback Towers, and Towers near Keeps will now reduce Hero armor, and the reduction has been increased from -10/-20 Armor to -20/-40 Armor.

• Fallback Towers have the same HP and Attack Damage as Keep Towers.

• Forts, Keeps, and the Core will no longer grant Allied Heroes that take damage in their radius 35 Armor for 4 seconds.

• The comeback system has been slightly magnified, particularly at wide level gaps.

• Alterac Pass Cavalry now gain more health in the later stages of the game.

• Cavalry now take 60% damage from structures (up from 50%).

• Early capture time reduced from 30 seconds to 25 seconds. The first spawn only spawns a single defending unit.

• Braxis Holdout Early objectives have lowered in health by 15%, but scaling has been increased significantly after 15 minutes.

• Garden of Terror Garden Terror health scaling increased.

• Garden Terror structure disabling plant bulb now damages itself at 10% per second (up from 6%).

• Infernal Shrines Early objectives have lowered in health by 15%, but scaling has been increased significantly after 15 minutes.

• Warhead Junction Nuke damage has been changed to flat, scaling damage. Scaling is updated when a Warhead is picked up.

• Nukes now deal double damage versus Forts, Keeps, and the Core.

Balance Update

General

• Pinnacle Rewards have been added to mutiple Heroes. These will be hard to obtain but provide powerful rewards.

Heroes

Falstad

Talents

• Level 1 Dishonorable Discharge REWORK: Bonuses are now provided at 20/45/75 hits. At 20 hits, gain 30% damage. At 45 hits, gain 75% damage and reduces the cooldown by 2 seconds. Pinnacle Reward: At 75 hits, Lightning Rod provides 2 additional strikes.

• Frequent Flyer REWORK: Reduced attack speed bonus from 40% to 25%. Now provides 1 stack per minion and 5 stacks per Hero. At 50 stacks, gain 20 attack damage. At 125 stacks, gain 50 attack damage. Pinnacle Reward: At 300 stacks, gain 125 attack damage.

• Gathering Storm REWORK: Bonuses are now provided at 30/80/150 stacks, rather than incremental gains. At 30 stacks, gain 30% damage. At 80 stacks, gain 50% damage. Pinnacle Reward: At 150 stacks, gain 70% damage.

• REWORK: Lose 8 stacks on death, but can not lose milestones that have already been completed.

• Level 7 Charged Up Moved to be a Level 13 Talent.

• No longer provides additional hits, but instead provides cooldown refresh on Hero takedowns.

• Level 13 Thunderstrikes Moved to be a Level 7 Talent.

Guldan

Talents

• Level 1 Echoed Corruption Increased stack requirement to 60. Pinnacle Reward: At 100 stacks, Corruption now heals for 50% of the damage dealt.

• Pursuit of Flame Increased radius from 10% to 15%.

• Reworded to say "Fel Flame's area is increased by 33%".

• You now lose 6 stacks upon death and can not lose progress upon completion.

Kerrigan

Base

• Primal Grasp [E] Cooldown reduced from 10 to 8.

• Delayed damage reduced from 195 to 165.

• Initial damage increased from 25 to 40.

• Ravage [Q] Damage reduced from 130 to 115.

• Now includes a baseline quest: Kill enemies within 1.5 seconds of hitting them with Ravage. Minions grant 1 progress and Heroes grant 5. At 75 stacks, Ravage gains 125 damage. Pinnacle Reward: At 125 stacks, Ravage gains 200 additional damage.

• Impaling Blades [W] Cooldown reduced from 12 seconds to 9 seconds.

• Damage reduced from 165 to 150.

• Radius increased from 1.5 to 1.65.

• Stun duration reduced from 1 second to .75 seconds.

• Assimilation [D] Increased the amount of shield gained from Basic Attacks from 10% to 20% of damage dealt.

Talents

• Level 1 Fury of the Swarm No longer increases shields gained from Basic Attacks.

• Level 4 Sharpened Blades Talent has been removed.

• Ravaging Ferocity NEW: Gain 25% attack speed for 3 seconds after using Ravage.

• Level 7 Boundless Fury Cooldown increased from 10 seconds to 12 seconds.

• Queen of Blades Cooldown reduction reduced from 3 seconds to 4 seconds.

• Level 10 Summon Ultralisk Damage reduced from 250 to 225.

• Level 13 Chrysalis HP lowered from 750 to 650.

• Reduced the amount of health regenerated from 5% max health per second to 4%.

• Level 16 Painful Spikes Damage reduced from 70 to 60.

• Level 20 Omegastorm Increased extended duration from .25 seconds per hit to .4 seconds per hit.

Sylvanas

Base

• Black Arrows [D] Black Arrows now refers to what was previously called "Banshee's Curse".

• New Baseline Quest: Deal damage to non-minions with 3 stacks of black arrows. At 200 stacks, increased the damage bonus of Black Arrows to 50%. Pinnacle Reward: At 400 stacks, heal for 50% of damage dealt against enemies with 3 stacks of Black Arrows.

• Reduced base damage bonus of Black Arrows to 15%.

• Activatable portion of Black Arrows has been removed.

Talents

• Level 1 Unfurling Shadows Talent has been removed.

• Unrelenting Torment NEW: Increases the damage of Shadow Dagger by 20% and increase its duration by 1 second.

• Level 4 Haunting Arrows NEW: You can now activate Black Arrows to cause all damage dealt to stun non-heroes. 90 second cooldown, reduced by 3 seconds when attacking a structure.

• Possession Now a Baseline ability. 25 seconds to restore each charge, 2 seconds cooldown. Max 4 charges.

• Level 7 Barbed Shot Bonus damage increased from 350% to 400%.

• Lost Soul REWORK: Reduces the cooldown of Shadow Dagger when attacking non-minions with 3 stacks of Black Arrows by .75 seconds, doubled against Heroes.

• Level 13 Windrunner Recast window reduced from 5 seconds to 4 seconds.

Thrall

Talents

• Level 1 Crash Lightning REWORK: Bonuses are now provided at 15 and 30 stacks. At each milestone, Chain Lightning gains 240 damage. Lose 6 stacks on death, but can not lose milestones that have already been completed.

• Echo of the Elements REWORK: Bonuses are now provided at 20/40/100 stacks. At 20 stacks, reduce mana cost of Chain Lightning by 20. At 40 stacks, Chain Lightning will bounce one additional time. Pinnacle Reward: At 100 stacks, Chain Lightning gains an extra charge.

• Rolling Thunder Moved to be a Level 7 Talent.

• No longer increases Chain Lightning bounces by 1.

• Level 7 Maelstrom Weapon Moved to be a Level 1 Talent.

• REWORK: Bonuses are now provided at 20/40/100 stacks, rather than incremental gains. At 20 stacks, gain 20 damage. At 40 stacks, gain 40 damage in addition to the previous benefits. Pinnacle Reward: At 100 stacks, Frostwolf Resilience now provides +200% Healing.

• Thunderstorm Increased damage bonus provided at max stacks from 25% to 30%.

• Level 20 Wind Rush Cooldown increased from 80 seconds to 90 seconds.

Zul'jin

Base

• Basic Attack damage decreased from 96 to 94.

• You Want Axe? [D] No longer has a cap on stacks.

• Now causes Zul'jin to lose 3 stacks (15 hits) on death.

Talents

• Level 1 Headhunter Increased damage bonus per hero kill from 2% to 2.5%.

Bug Fixes

Map

• Blackheart's Bay Fixed an issue that caused the Battleground Objective to not start if a particular chest is the last destroyed chest.

• Fixed an issue that caused the help text for attacking the Treasure Chest to not disappear if a particular chest is attacked.

• Warhead Junction Fixed Warhead Junction Nuke Damage Dealt tracking.

Heroes

• Fixed an issue that caused Big Top Gazlowe's Firin' Mah Lazorz to create permanent visuals.

• Living Bomb will now apply its effects if the target dies with Living Bomb.

• Valla Base Hatred [D] Fixed Hatred Tooltip.

• Zagara Level 1 Infest Fixed Infest active current bonus tooltip.
